name: Jamjoom Pharmaceuticals Factory Company
summary: Established in 1994, Jamjoom Pharmaceuticals Factory Company, headquartered in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, is a key player in the production and commercialization of medicinal products. The firm serves markets both within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and across various international regions. Its extensive product portfolio addresses a wide array of therapeutic needs, covering ophthalmology, dermatology, gastrointestinal issues, cardiovascular health, central nervous system disorders, as well as general medicine, over-the-counter remedies, and nutraceuticals/consumer health products.
